title: Operator window
brief: Operator window of Global Service Studio: close to what ProPresenter operators expect, more modern, with very simple views. Several configurable outputs (center, sides, stage teleprompter, key output for a switcher).

artboards.title: Classic three-pane
artboards.tradeoff: Most familiar to a ProPresenter operator and shows everything at once; dense, with three zones competing for attention

artboards.title: Live focus
artboards.tradeoff: Fewest decisions for an untrained volunteer: NOW, NEXT and one key; browsing and editing are one step away

artboards.title: Outputs wall
artboards.tradeoff: Best answer to what every screen shows right now; leaves less than half the height for slides and is visually heavier

artboards.title: Native · Live
artboards.tradeoff: The calmest view during the service: a red LIVE panel for what is on screen, Next beside it, and two rows of five slides that follow the live one; editing is one mode switch away

artboards.title: Native · Prepare
artboards.tradeoff: Guided song builder for a beginner: pick a part of the song, type its words, see its slides; shows one part at a time instead of the whole song

artboards.title: Native · Live (ultrawide)
artboards.tradeoff: Uses the whole ultrawide width with output monitors and a full-height grid of large slides, 5 per row, that continues into the rest of the service; the live panel gives up width to the grid (about 910 by 512), so it is less dominant than the width would allow
